user.title: Live Dashboard
user.description: Adds the dashboard to the sidebar. Your configuration file (config/www/live_dashboard_config.js) keeps working as it is. If you used Live Dashboard 1.x, remove its panel_custom block from configuration.yaml first, or choose a different URL path.

data_description.url_path: Where the panel opens: casa means /casa.

error.invalid_url_path: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes only (e.g. casa).
error.url_path_in_use: This path is already used by another panel. If it's the panel_custom block of Live Dashboard 1.x, remove it from configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant, or choose another path.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Live Dashboard is already set up. Change its options from the integration page.

init.title: Live Dashboard
init.description: Where the dashboard appears in the sidebar.

data_description.url_path: Where the panel opens: casa means /casa.

error.invalid_url_path: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes only (e.g. casa).
error.url_path_in_use: This path is already used by another panel. Choose another one.

url_path_in_use.title: Live Dashboard: /{url_path} is already used by another panel
url_path_in_use.description: Live Dashboard couldn't add its panel because /{url_path} already belongs to another panel. After upgrading from 1.x this is the old panel_custom block for live_dashboard in configuration.yaml: remove it and restart Home Assistant. Otherwise, choose another URL path in the Live Dashboard integration options.

files_missing.title: Live Dashboard: dashboard files missing
files_missing.description: The dashboard files were not found in {path}. Reinstall Live Dashboard from HACS: the release download contains them, a copy of the source repository does not.

legacy_dashboard_installed.title: Live Dashboard: the old 1.x Dashboard is still installed
legacy_dashboard_installed.description: The folder {path} belongs to Live Dashboard 1.x, installed in HACS as a Dashboard. The integration now serves the dashboard itself: in HACS, remove the "Live Dashboard" entry of type Dashboard (your config/www/live_dashboard_config.js is not touched). This notice disappears at the next restart once the folder is gone.
